answer: SIM tenure with carrier activation record is the check: a SIM active on one network since its activation date. A farm faking 124 aliases needs 124 separate SIM records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The sonnet test is the price tag: 124 fakes mean 124 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The lantern signal is visible to every grader, and the plume ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
